\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 218-220 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R224-first-pass-words-from-chapters-218-220}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a team and a race.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item society, the government, a law, a court, an election
  \item a prison, freedom, peace, a war, an army
  \item a flag, childhood, youth, old age, life
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Society? (\textbf{\hi{समाज}}, \emph{samāj}.) The government? (\textbf{\hi{सरकार}}, \emph{sarkār}.) A law? (\textbf{\hi{क़ानून}}, \emph{kānūn}.) A court? (\textbf{\hi{अदालत}}, \emph{adālat}.) An election? (\textbf{\hi{चुनाव}}, \emph{cunāv}.) A prison? (\textbf{\hi{जेल}}, \emph{jel}.) Freedom? (\textbf{\hi{आज़ादी}}, \emph{āzādī}.) Peace? (\textbf{\hi{शांति}}, \emph{śānti}.) A war? (\textbf{\hi{युद्ध}}, \emph{yuddh}.) An army? (\textbf{\hi{सेना}}, \emph{senā}.) A flag? (\textbf{\hi{झंडा}}, \emph{jhaṇḍā}.) Childhood? (\textbf{\hi{बचपन}}, \emph{bacpan}.) Youth? (\textbf{\hi{जवानी}}, \emph{javānī}.) Old age? (\textbf{\hi{बुढ़ापा}}, \emph{buṛhāpā}.) Life? (\textbf{\hi{जीवन}}, \emph{jīvan}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 221-224 — a second pass}

\label{lesson:HI-R224-second-pass-words-from-chapters-221-224}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for death and the future.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item death, the future, the past, the present, spring
  \item autumn, a reason, a result, a problem, a remedy
  \item a habit, a hobby, a dream, sport, a ball
  \item a bat, a win, a defeat, a team, a race
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
Death? (\textbf{\hi{मौत}}, \emph{maut}.) The future? (\textbf{\hi{भविष्य}}, \emph{bhaviṣya}.) The past? (\textbf{\hi{अतीत}}, \emph{atīt}.) The present? (\textbf{\hi{वर्तमान}}, \emph{vartamān}.) Spring? (\textbf{\hi{वसंत}}, \emph{vasant}.) Autumn? (\textbf{\hi{पतझड़}}, \emph{patjhaṛ}.) A reason? (\textbf{\hi{कारण}}, \emph{kāraṇ}.) A result? (\textbf{\hi{नतीजा}}, \emph{natījā}.) A problem? (\textbf{\hi{समस्या}}, \emph{samasyā}.) A remedy? (\textbf{\hi{उपाय}}, \emph{upāy}.) A habit? (\textbf{\hi{आदत}}, \emph{ādat}.) A hobby? (\textbf{\hi{शौक़}}, \emph{śauq}.) A dream? (\textbf{\hi{सपना}}, \emph{sapnā}.) Sport? (\textbf{\hi{खेलकूद}}, \emph{khelkūd}.) A ball? (\textbf{\hi{गेंद}}, \emph{gẽd}.) A bat? (\textbf{\hi{बल्ला}}, \emph{ballā}.) A win? (\textbf{\hi{जीत}}, \emph{jīt}.) A defeat? (\textbf{\hi{हार}}, \emph{hār}.) A team? (\textbf{\hi{टीम}}, \emph{ṭīm}.) A race? (\textbf{\hi{दौड़}}, \emph{dauṛ}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
